title: Towards a Critical Race Methodology in Algorithmic Fairness
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not contain a benchmark and does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It mentions 'religion' as a legally protected class in the US but does not analyze it.
findings: This paper does not analyze or make any findings related to religion. Its focus is exclusively on race as a social construct in algorithmic fairness.
